name: ghidra
description: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework
one_liner: A free tool from the NSA that lets you take apart and understand compiled software you don't have the source code for.
buyer: A cybersecurity consultancy that analyzes malware or audits closed-source binaries for clients.
business_use_cases: A security firm reverse-engineers a piece of malware for an incident-response client report.
A consultancy audits a vendor's closed-source binary for hidden vulnerabilities before a client signs a contract with them.
A game preservationist reverse-engineers an old game's binary to build a fan patch or port.

money_ideas.idea: Run a paid "Ghidra bootcamp" training course for aspiring security researchers and junior analysts.
Offer malware-triage-as-a-service to smaller companies who can't afford a full in-house security team, using Ghidra's headless mode.

steal_this: Put together a paid weekend "reverse engineering for beginners" course using Ghidra and sell it to junior security analysts wanting to break into the field.
